_doc: Phone OS light theme (docs/PHONE.md): the in-game screen canvas (design px on a 640 x 1136 screen), the companion page (CSS variables, injected by the game) and the HUD phone panel (1080p design px, scaled like the HUD). Colours RGBA 0-255.

panel._doc: HUD panel (the simulated phone screen): height = hud_phone_size x screen height, portrait at the phone screen's aspect, in the hud_phone_corner corner of the HUD safe area; bottom-right it sits above the item / ammo readout (readout_gap).
